STAGE: idea selection for round_20261031_101346_116 (ideation_3, 1 idea, no write tool).
GOAL: pick a coupling position not covered by prior rounds (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID per-level curvature from prefix-transition score, BRad-RQ behaviour-ranked radial assignment, BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, TSG-SID, SUCC-GEO-CBTAB, LORENTZ-SUCCPROFILE-SMOOTH-RQ, behcone-prefix-rq, succboost-geoshift).
WHAT I READ: the round brief only; the agent workdir contains no repo code and progress.jsonl / running.json are permission-denied, so no baseline numbers (r0, K, L, M) could be read. All constants in the proposal are therefore written as measured/derived quantities rather than literals.
OBSERVATION FROM BRIEF: last four rounds falsified partition rebuilds; the round now demands an explicit admissibility predicate on the negative side, a bound derived from the measured baseline negative-hit rate, a validation L1 negative-hit-rate diagnostic, and a partition left untouched or nearly so.
REASONING: the only artefact Stage 3 consumes is the item->SID tuple, so any mechanism that can move recall must change the map. The safest corner of the design space is therefore a deterministic, certificate-gated repair of the DEEPEST code only, with levels 1..L-1 bit-identical by construction (so no new prefixes, no vocabulary change, baseline Stage-3 comparability retained), where the repair score is a product of a behaviour agreement term and a Poincare-metric term on a behaviour-displaced point. Chosen because it is a post-Stage-2 pass (frozen budget untouched), deterministic (no seed, no sweep, no arm), and it fails safe: zero admissible moves => exact baseline.
OPEN: none for ideation; the proposal carries the three switches in-code without training any off-arm.

STAGE: complete answer (final record, stands alone).
IDEA: HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR - prefix-preserving, certificate-gated hyperbolic leaf-code repair of the frozen RQ-VAE SIDs.
SUMMARY: keep levels 1..L-1 bit-identical; build a popularity-adjusted transition graph on the TRAIN split only; measure the baseline TRAIN-split L1 negative-hit rate r0 and derive the coherence bound B=ln((1-r0)/r0); place each item as a point in a unit Poincare ball from the prefix-anchored curved residual, displace it by the hyperbolic gyromidpoint with its behavioural neighbours, score candidate deepest codes by q_behaviour(k') * exp(-d_kappa(v_i, c_k')), and accept a move only if it does not increase either the split behaviour-coherent neighbour count or the same-cell behaviour-disjoint count AND the item's level-L residual stays inside the target cell's own measured radius. Reports validation L1 negative-hit rate pre/post as the diagnostic; zero admissible moves means an exact no-op and the baseline numbers are recorded as a negative result.
WHY NOT A REBUILD: the deepest token is the only mutable object, the prefix tuple is asserted identical in code, vocabulary is unchanged, Stage-3 architecture/epochs unchanged, one deterministic pass after Stage-2 epoch 3000 with no extra optimizer steps, no seed, no ablation arm trained, no tuned constant (every threshold measured or derived).
Full block text (as printed in the reply) is the deliverable; the reply body is authoritative.
